title: Kestrel and the Compass
author: Tamsin Nystrom
blurb: Gideon Sterling, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
